testcases.title: GEO-61-TC006 — [SKIP] Question and competitor updates are persisted
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires saving actual question or competitor modifications on a live staging report, which is a destructive action affecting real analysis data. Re-enable once a dedicated test report or sandbox environment is available.

testcases.title: GEO-61-TC007 — [SKIP] Add Country disabled when max_brand_markets quota reached
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires the organization to have reached the max_brand_markets quota on staging. This state cannot be reliably reproduced without consuming all remaining quota slots. Re-enable with a dedicated quota-exhausted test account.

testcases.title: GEO-61-TC008 — [SKIP] Add Topic disabled when max_categories quota reached
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires the organization to have reached the max_categories quota on staging. Re-enable with a dedicated quota-exhausted test account.

testcases.title: GEO-61-TC009 — [SKIP] Reader role sees Manage Scope in read-only mode
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires authentication with a Reader-role account. Re-enable once a dedicated Reader test account (GEO_READER_EMAIL + GEO_READER_PASSWORD) is configured in the .env file.

testcases.title: GEO-60-TC002 — [SKIP] Cannot disable the last active LLM
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires disabling 4 of 5 LLMs sequentially on the live staging report. This modifies the live report configuration in a hard-to-reverse way. Re-enable with a sandbox report or dedicated test account where LLM changes are safely reversible.

testcases.title: GEO-60-TC003 — [SKIP] LLM configuration persists until modified again
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires saving an LLM configuration change (destructive) as a prerequisite. Re-enable with a dedicated sandbox report.

testcases.title: GEO-60-TC004 — [SKIP] Minimum 1 LLM constraint shows tooltip when last LLM toggle is attempted
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires disabling 4 LLMs to reach the single-active-LLM state. Destructive multi-step sequence on live staging data. Re-enable with a sandbox environment or a pre-configured 1-LLM test report.

testcases.title: GEO-60-TC005 — [SKIP] Last active LLM toggle is visually disabled
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Same prerequisite as TC004: reaching the single-active-LLM state requires destructive actions on the live staging report. Re-enable with a dedicated 1-LLM test report.

testcases.title: GEO-60-TC006 — [SKIP] Web Search checkbox visible and interactive on enabled LLM card
testcases.error: SKIPPED — DOM inspection confirmed the "Web search" feature is NOT present on the Manage Scope page for this dashboard (6dc13f88). LLM cards show only name + toggle. Re-enable if/when the Web search checkbox is deployed to the staging environment.

testcases.title: GEO-60-TC007 — [SKIP] Web search checkbox grayed out on disabled LLM card
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Feature absent (see TC006) AND requires a pre-configured disabled-LLM state.

testcases.title: GEO-60-TC008 — [SKIP] Reader role sees AI Engines in read-only mode
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires authentication with a Reader-role account. Re-enable once a dedicated Reader test account is configured in .env.

testcases.title: GEO-60-TC009 — [SKIP] LLM configuration persists after navigation
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires saving an LLM configuration change (destructive) as a prerequisite. Re-enable with a dedicated sandbox report where changes are safely reversible.
